Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.78 - Synced upstream Wrath Combo 1.0.4.14
- New per-encounter BattleData system: curated tankbuster / raidwide / invulnerability detection across all expansions (ARR through Dawntrail).
- Raidwide detection now combines upstream's encounter data with the existing cast-bar heuristic, and filters out gaze / ignored actions.
- Absorbed 68 upstream commits of job and targeting fixes (WrathCombo 1.0.4.13 to 1.0.4.14).
- All GluttonyCombo customizations preserved: Amnesia / Pacification / Silence handling, Pyretic / Reflect penalties, 15s raidwide-mitigation gate, WHM ground-heal targeting, SMN Aegis Uptime, and IPC controls.
